scenario: Following first page and anonymous recommendation first page with shared Redis cache
measurement_type: short bounded burst; not a sustained or multi-host capacity result

workload.cache_priming: one cold miss followed by a shared-cache hit; the Redis key and live TTL are checked before each burst
workload.pass_criteria: all responses valid; at least 95% cache hits per scene; zero request failures

limitations: Both API processes and Redis/MySQL ran on one WSL2 host.
The test measures a short warm-cache burst, not cache expiry, sustained load, multiple hosts, or user-specific recommendation caching.
Latency and throughput values are local observations and are not production SLOs or cross-machine performance promises.
The runner reported zero remaining API processes, isolated schemas, MySQL users, and temporary Redis containers after each run.

Original response checks accepted nonempty unique subsets of the 24 seeded videos, and candidate_sql delta was logged rather than asserted. The reviewed implementation requires all 24 videos and explicitly asserts zero candidate SQL.
latency_measurement: Historical: request start through response headers; excludes response-body transfer. Reviewed implementation measures through full body consumption.
